corrections.reason: The printed text on Column 2 Line 22 begins directly with አኀዙ (without a preceding ወ).

Visually the first word is ካንስ (4th order ካ, 6th order ን, 6th order ስ, meaning 'with respect to a small/little amount'), which directly explains the following Ge'ez proof-text 'ወበውስተ ውሁድኒ ትብል አልቦ' ('and concerning a little thing you say there is none').
Restore word separation between the Amharic verb አላለም and the Ge'ez citation ወበውስተ.
